prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.rs with the public function at module scope.
Required API: pub fn stable_frequencies(input: &str) -> Option<String>
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed integers in -1000..1000. For each distinct value in first-occurrence order, return value:count, joined by commas. Reject every malformed input by returning the language-specific absence value.
Visible example: 4,2,4,4,2 returns 4:3,2:2.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn stable_frequencies(s:&str)->Option<String>{let m=4;let(mut a,mut k,mut lo,mut hi)=(vec![],0usize,0,0);if m==3{let q:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if q.len()!=2{return None}let x=nums(q[0])?;a=nums(q[1])?;if x.len()!=1||x[0]<0{return None}k=x[0]as usize%a.len()}else if m==5{let q:Vec<_>=s.split(';').collect();if q.len()!=3{return None}let x=nums(q[0])?;let y=nums(q[1])?;a=nums(q[2])?;if x.len()!=1||y.len()!=1||x[0]>y[0]{return None}lo=x[0];hi=y[0]}else{a=nums(s)?}let mut o=vec![];if m==0{for i in 1..a.len(){o.push((a[i]-a[i-1]).clamp(-1000,1000))}}else if m==1{let mut z=a[0];for x in a{z=z.max(x);o.push(z)}}else if m==2{o=vec![0;a.len()];let mut z=a[a.len()-1];for i in(0..a.len()).rev(){z=z.min(a[i]);o[i]=z}}else if m==3{o.extend_from_slice(&a[a.len()-k..]);o.extend_from_slice(&a[..a.len()-k])}else if m==4{let mut seen=std::collections::HashSet::new();return Some(a.iter().filter(|x|seen.insert(**x)).map(|x|format!("{}:{}",x,a.iter().filter(|y|*y==x).count())).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(","))}else if m==5{o=a.into_iter().map(|x|x.clamp(lo,hi)).collect()}else if m==6{for i in 1..a.len(){o.push(a[i-1]*a[i])}}else if m==7{o.extend(a.iter().filter(|x|**x%2==0).copied());o.extend(a.iter().filter(|x|**x%2!=0).copied())}else if m==8{let mut z=0;for(i,x)in a.into_iter().enumerate(){if i%2==0{z+=x}else{z-=x}o.push(z)}}else{let(mut bv,mut bl,mut cv,mut cl)=(a[0],1,a[0],1);for x in a.into_iter().skip(1){if x==cv{cl+=1}else{cv=x;cl=1}if cl>bl{bv=cv;bl=cl}}return Some(format!("{}:{}",bv,bl))}Some(join(&o))}
